title: Competence-Preserving Resume Perturbations Expose Presentation Sensitivity in LLM Screening
abstract: arXiv:2609.16517v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Resume screeners must infer job-relevant competence from resumes whose presentation can vary substantially in wording, structure, stylistic polish, and document extraction quality. Ideally, such surface variation should not change decisions when the underlying qualification evidence is unchanged. We introduce a controlled audit of this property, constructing occupation-grounded candidate profiles at controlled competence levels and rendering each profile into multiple resume presentations. A deterministic validation gate excludes variants that alter the underlying evidence before scoring. Across six open instruction-tuned LLM conditions, we find a clear disconnect between screening validity and presentation stability. Llama-3.1-8B with its native chat template achieves the strongest validity ($0.781$) yet reverses $29.6\%$ of matched pairwise decisions under competence-preserving presentation changes; Mistral-7B-v0.3 reaches validity $

translated_title: 能力保持型简历扰动揭示大语言模型筛选中的表述敏感性
translated_abstract: 简历筛选系统必须从表述方式差异巨大的简历中推断与工作相关的能力，这些差异体现在措辞、结构、文风润色以及文档提取质量上。理想情况下，当底层资格证据不变时，这种表面变化不应改变筛选决策。我们引入了对这一特性的受控审计，构建了在受控能力水平上基于具体职业的候选人档案，并将每个档案渲染为多种简历表述形式。一个确定性的验证门会在评分前排除改变底层证据的变体。在六个开源指令微调大语言模型条件下，我们发现筛选有效性与表述稳定性之间存在明显脱节。使用原生聊天模板的Llama-3.1-8B达到了最强的筛选有效性（0.781），但在保持能力不变的表述变化下，其匹配成对决策中有29.6%被反转；Mistral-7B-v0.3达到有效性……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种受控审计框架，通过在保持能力证据不变的前提下对简历进行多种表述形式的扰动，揭示了开源大语言模型简历筛选中有效性与表述稳定性之间的严重脱节，即使有效性最强的模型也有近三成的成对决策因表面表述变化而被反转。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a controlled audit framework using competence-preserving resume perturbations to expose a clear disconnect between screening validity and presentation stability in open-source LLM resume screening, with even the strongest model reversing nearly 30% of matched pairwise decisions under surface presentation changes.
